Para un agente empresarial productivo, no un prototipo, el rango en LATAM es:

  • Agente simple (un caso de uso, 2–3 integraciones): USD 25.000–45.000.

  • Agente complejo (multi-agente, orquestación, compliance, alta disponibilidad): USD 100.000–250.000.

contentEs.new:
Para un agente empresarial productivo, no un prototipo, el costo depende del alcance y se define en el discovery. Estos son los niveles de complejidad que más lo mueven:

  • Agente simple (un caso de uso, 2–3 integraciones): el alcance más acotado y, por lo general, el mejor punto de partida.

  • Agente medio (flujo multi-paso, RAG sobre base de conocimiento, 4–6 integraciones): exige más trabajo de datos e integración.

Real costs: implementation, operation, maintenance

Budget conversations need numbers, not ranges marketed as "enterprise pricing." Here is the actual cost structure.
contentEn.new:
Costs: implementation, operation, maintenance

Budget conversations get simpler when you separate one-time costs (implementation) from recurring ones (operation). Here is how the cost structure breaks down.

contentEn.old:
A production-grade enterprise agent implementation in LATAM, delivered by a premium firm, typically lands in these ranges:

  • Single use case, 1–2 integrations, clear data: USD 45,000–80,000.

  • Multi-integration, moderate complexity, some data cleanup: USD 80,000–180,000.

  • Complex, multi-agent system with governance, compliance, multi-system integration: USD 180,000–450,000.

These cover discovery, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and 30–60 days of post-launch stabilization. Beware of anyone quoting USD 15,000 for a production enterprise agent—what you will get is a demo, not a system.
contentEn.new:
For a production-grade enterprise agent, not a prototype, cost depends on scope and is defined during discovery. These are the complexity levels that move it most:

  • Single use case, 1–2 integrations, clear data: the most contained scope and usually the best starting point.

  • Multi-integration, moderate complexity, some data cleanup: more data and integration work.

  • Complex, multi-agent system with governance, compliance, multi-system integration: the largest design, testing, and governance effort.

Implementation covers discovery, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and a post-launch stabilization period. Be wary of quotes that look too low for a production enterprise agent—what you will get is a demo, not a system.
